title: Support Sounds of Saving
meta_description: Every gift to Sounds of Saving funds one of three things: a classroom, a film, or a tour stop. Donate, partner with us, or volunteer.
heading: Where your gift goes
lead: Sounds of Saving is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with a small team and no overhead to speak of. Every dollar funds one of three things, and each of them puts music to work for a young person's mental health.

uses.title: SoS HS in a new school
uses.body: Five sessions, materials, facilitator time, and an artist visit. Your gift lets a school run the program with no cost to the school and no extra staffing.
uses.alt: Musicians visiting a high school for SoS HS

uses.title: A Song That Found Me at the Right Time session
uses.body: A crew, a room, and an afternoon with an artist who is ready to talk honestly. Produced with the 988 Lifeline and published where young people already are.
uses.alt: An artist filming a Song That Found Me at the Right Time session

uses.title: Resources where care is hard to find
uses.body: A mental-health professional and a 988 counselor at the table, wallet crisis cards with a QR code to local resources, and the cards we collect from fans.
uses.alt: Fans at a festival holding Songs That Found Me cards

donate.heading: Donate
donate.body: One-time or monthly. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.

other_ways.title: Partner with us
other_ways.body: Artists, labels, festivals, venues, and mission-aligned brands: we make films, live activations, and social content that don't feel like a PSA, and we bring resources to your shows.

cta.label: Talk to us about a partnership

other_ways.title: Bring SoS HS to a school
other_ways.body: Counselors, SEL leads, and administrators can start a pilot conversation for the 2026 to 2027 school year.

other_ways.title: Volunteer
other_ways.body: We need help at tables on tour and at festivals, with photography and film, and with research and writing. Tell us what you're good at and where you are.
